findings.summary: The first screen opens with English index names, so an older reader feels the page is not meant for them and may give up.
The minus signs next to the chosen fund (-0.04%, -1,030 ₪) look like a loss and frighten the reader, which could lead them to a wrong decision.
Grey text on a dark background is hard to read on every screen, even when enlarged.
The cheapest choice is a company the reader doesn't know rather than a big bank. This is about trust and preference, not a page fault.
The amounts are set with sliders. The reader names no real obstacle.
The colours in the cost bar are too close together and the legend uses jargon, so the reader cannot tell which part of the bar is which fee.
The fund list is long and each row is crowded with numbers. This is tiring but does not stop the reader.
The starting amount (10,000) and the monthly amount (500) were already filled in and were not the reader's own figures. This is a minor annoyance.
